headline.caveat: 'up to $5B' committed Nov 18, 2025; amount actually funded to date undisclosed

realized_to_date.caveat: funding schedule and amounts drawn never disclosed

nature_md: Part of the Nov 18, 2025 three-way announcement with NVIDIA: Microsoft commits to invest **up to $5B** in Anthropic (NVIDIA up to $10B), in the round context that put Anthropic's valuation around $350B, while Anthropic simultaneously commits $30B of Azure purchases and Claude becomes available across Microsoft's Copilot family and Azure — the only frontier model present on all three major clouds. The extraordinary geometry: Microsoft, owner of ~27% of OpenAI, buying equity in OpenAI's chief rival whose Azure spend it will book as revenue. How much has actually been funded has never been disclosed — headline and realized may differ materially.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: If/as funded: non-marketable equity investment at fair value; 'up to' language means no disclosed obligation timetable. Immaterial to Microsoft's balance sheet at $5B scale but strategically hedges its OpenAI concentration.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity financing paired with a $30B customer commitment to the investor's cloud — the same equity-for-compute exchange as Amazon/Google rounds, extending Anthropic's pattern of taking money from every hyperscaler whose capacity it consumes.

events.title: Microsoft (≤$5B) and NVIDIA (≤$10B) announce Anthropic investments; $30B Azure commitment
